The bar chart is configured and the form is valid.

- **Dataset:** "Concentrations horaires de polluants dans l'air ambiant issues du réseau permanent de mesures automatiques - Poitiers". The suggestion list has this name twice (indexes 12 and 20, same URL prefix). I used index 12. If you meant the other entry, tell me and I'll switch it.
- **Chart type:** Histogramme (bar), with the "Grouper les lignes" data mode.
- **Grouping:** by `nom_com` (commune), with the maximum set to 200 so every commune is included instead of the default 10.
- **Value:** average (`avg`) of the `valeur` column.
- **Title:** "Pollution by commune".
- **Legend position:** right.

The dataset holds several pollutants (`nom_poll`, `metrique`), and I did not add a filter. So each bar is the average across all pollutants and measurements in that commune. If you want one pollutant, such as NO2, I can add a filter on `nom_poll`.
